description: --placer sa places LUT and flip-flop pairs whose LUT also drives a flip-flop outside the pair
exercises: the simulated-annealing placer (--placer sa), an engine option apio does not use
the legalisation of relative constraints on the LUT and flip-flop pairs of the xilinx packer
why: openXC7/nextpnr#92: with --placer sa the legaliser placed such a pair on the 5LUT and the 5FF of a position, where the LUT output and the 5FF output both need the one output mux, and did not check the pair itself; the SA then ended with 'post-placement validity check failed for Bel ... (no cell)'. The fix keeps the legaliser searching when the bels of the chain it places are illegal.
